description: This is a shell script that automates the setup and configuration of a testing environment for Cuttlefish on Android. It includes functions to install packages, check service status, load kernel modules, grant device access, and create test users, and it processes command-line options to customize these actions.

methods.name: install_pkgs
methods.description: Installs specified Debian packages from a given directory.

methods.name: check_service_started
methods.description: Checks if a given system service is active.

methods.name: load_kernel_modules
methods.description: Loads specified kernel modules using modprobe.

methods.name: grant_device_access
methods.description: Changes permissions to grant read/write access to device nodes.

methods.name: create_test_user
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified groups and sets permissions on their home directory.
